notes: Curated degraded substitutes. An operation references one by ID; inline definitions are rejected by the validator, because an invented stand-in is indistinguishable from fabrication. Three types: `reducing` does the same job worse, `deferred` stages the work locally and hands off, `no-op` does nothing and reports the gap.
defaults_note: Capability -> stand-in, used only when the extractor finds no better option. Curated here rather than generated, so a stand-in is always a declared choice. Capabilities absent from this map (notably audio.tts) have no honest substitute and will correctly halt at ask-user instead.

standins.desc: Render the scene's title text on a solid gradient card at 1920x1080 via FFmpeg
standins.caveat: Output looks like a slideshow, not footage. Suitable only where motion is decorative.

standins.desc: Composite the title on a high-contrast gradient card at 1280x720 via FFmpeg
standins.caveat: No imagery, no subject. Fine as a placeholder, weak as a thumbnail.

standins.desc: Pan and zoom slowly across a single still image to produce apparent motion
standins.caveat: Reads as motion without generating any. Cheap and usually better than a static card.

standins.desc: Derive an SRT from the script text using per-scene timing estimates
standins.caveat: Timings are estimated, not measured, so captions drift from the audio.

standins.desc: Cut vertical clips at scene boundaries via FFmpeg with no reframing
standins.caveat: Subjects will be cropped out. No face tracking, no safe-area awareness.

standins.desc: Reason about the subject from model knowledge alone, with no live sources
standins.caveat: No citations and no freshness. Must be labelled as unsourced in the output.

standins.desc: Flag claims that look unverifiable without live sources, rather than checking them
standins.caveat: Detection is heuristic. A claim that looks fine may still be wrong.

standins.desc: Write the inputs and instructions to a handoff file, and stop for a human to run the step elsewhere
standins.caveat: The pipeline does not complete. This is the honest option when nothing can substitute.

standins.desc: Skip the step and record the omission in the output manifest
standins.caveat: Only legal for optional operations. A required operation routed here is a bug.
